results.content: Behind every safe and productive workplace are people…and as they evolve, so do their needs, capabilities, and the risks linked to their activities 🌱👷♀️ Our new article "An exploratory study of workplace Occupational Safety and Health Interventions and their impact on productivity and performance in an Ageing Workforce", published in Safety Science, takes a closer look at how targeted OSH interventions can help organizations support an ageing workforce, keeping workplaces both safe and productive. An exploratory study of workplace Occupational Safety and Health Interventions and their impact on productivity and performance in an Ageing Workforce   sciencedirect.com. By prioritizing occupational health and safety, organizations can create a safe and productive work environment that benefits both employees and the organization as a whole. The findings show: 📊 Three out of four reported at least one workplace injury in the past year 💬 Nearly half said those incidents could have been prevented 💸 About one-third said their annual injury-related costs exceed $20,000 🧠 Nearly half identified mental health as their top workplace safety concern Our report highlights how proactive safety programs, consistent training, and genuine care for employee well-being can help reduce risks and potentially keep costs down.
